scope: W6 factual integration for all Western Provinces and Wilderness Achievement Diary tasks. It preserves package provenance, exact requirements, boostability, item fate, fixed tier rewards, current 2026 Wilderness boss-lair mechanics, and observation boundaries. It does not create actions, graph edges, account-state transitions, strategy scores, or a route.

facts_included: all 84 package tasks with exact requirement, input-fate, boostability, determinism, and source-provenance records
current 2026 Wilderness greater- and lesser-boss-lair alternative access facts
strategy_excluded: RNG, loot, collection-log, crop, daily, charge, or economic assumptions

requirements.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
requirements.tier_claim: Claiming a tier requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier.
requirements.boostability_default: Temporary boosts may satisfy skill requirements unless a task explicitly says otherwise. Combat-level and item equip requirements are not inferred boostable.

external_system_boundaries: Pest Control rounds, commendation points, Void ownership, and Elite Void upgrades are maintained by the Pest Control research package and existing diary utility fact; this record does not reproduce a minigame, points, ownership, or upgrade transition.

Zulrah access and the elite resurrection capability are referenced through the existing Western Provinces diary utility fact; the Zulrah kill, combat readiness, loot, death, and cooldown result remain explicit observations.

Tirannwn access, crystal-item acquisition, teleport-crystal charge lifecycle, and player-owned-house construction are existing systems. This record states only the individual diary gates and never grants crystal items, charges, or fixtures.

records.model_boundary: No task record creates an action, graph edge, account-state mutation, diary claim, combat readiness, kill, Pest Control point, Void item, chompy or jubbly counter, farm-growth state, catch, pickpocket, item drop, loot, pet, collection-log entry, daily claim, charge, or cooldown transition.

records.name: Wilderness Achievement Diary factual task record

requirements.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
requirements.tier_claim: Claiming a tier requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier. Claims are made from Lesser Fanatic east of the Edgeville jailhouse, outside the Wilderness.
requirements.boostability_default: Temporary boosts are allowed unless a task explicitly says otherwise. The fallen-Ent yew-log task explicitly requires 61 Woodcutting and is not boostable.
requirements.pvp_boundary: The Wilderness is a PvP area except Ferox Enclave, Mage Arena bank, Corporeal Beast's Lair, and King Black Dragon Lair. Being in a PvP area establishes exposure only; it does not establish survival, escape, combat readiness, another player's availability, or a result.
requirements.encounter_boundary: A diary task that requires a kill, successful hit, successful catch, successful harvest, or player interaction is player-confirmed. No normalized action may auto-complete those events from skills, equipment, access, or diary ownership.
requirements.resource_area_fees: Base entry is 7500 coins; claiming medium lowers it to 6000, hard to 3750, and elite makes entry free. A task can still be completed before its prior-tier reward is claimed by paying the applicable higher fee.
requirements.boss_lair_access: As checked, the greater Callisto/Venenatis/Vet'ion lairs require medium Wilderness Diary claimed or the matching boss Slayer task; lesser Artio/Spindel/Calvar'ion require hard Wilderness Diary claimed or the matching greater-boss Slayer task. These access exceptions do not make the corresponding elite kill task deterministic. The elite task's diary text accepts either variant for each family.

external_system_boundaries: Mage Arena I, god-spell access, Ancient Magicks, and spell transport are separate quest and spellbook systems; this record retains only diary task gates and exact spell inputs.

Wilderness boss lairs, obelisks, the Resource Area, Revenant Caves, and Wilderness transport are referenced through the current diary utility and transport facts. This record does not model admission fees, timers, routing, PvP safety, extraction, loot eligibility, drops, or collection-log results.

The 2026 greater-lair condition is Medium Wilderness Diary claimed or the matching boss Slayer task; the lesser-lair condition is Hard Wilderness Diary claimed or the matching greater-boss Slayer task. These are alternative access facts, never evidence of boss success.
